title: Hyphae v2: Hash-Chained Verbatim Quotation — A Verifiable Provenance Layer for Grounded Retrieval
description: Hyphae is a verifiable-provenance layer for grounded retrieval: it answers by emitting byte-identical quotations of stored memory fragments over a SHA-256 hash-chained journal, with no large language model in the cognition path, so every output span can be independently audited back to named, unaltered source fragments. The accompanying preprint frames verifiable provenance as an addable, realizer-independent layer; a trivial echo control (and echo+journal) shows that measured correctness and grounding are properties of verbatim quotation rather than of the system, while citation faithfulness -- whether the answer genuinely derives from its cited source rather than post-rationalising from a parametric prior -- is made trivially true by construction. Evaluation spans 18 LLM-based configurations (six models x three retrieval modes) across two corpora. This version (v2) archives the full provenance stack, each component implemented and adversarially demonstrated: an external Ed25519 head anchor (closes the chain-aware rewrite), an append-only anchor ledger (freshness + non-equivocation), an external witness (entry withholding), a signed keyring (key rotation), and a C2PA-aligned ingestion bridge (signed-at-source provenance into the journal). It also includes a community-scale provenance benchmark -- a tampering taxonomy x adversary matrix plus a defense-escalation experiment scoring the full stack -- and an offline multi-hop harness. Code is licensed Apache-2.0; documentation, corpora, and the preprint are licensed CC BY 4.0.
notes: Version 2: the full verifiable-provenance stack (external head anchor, append-only ledger, external witness, signed keyring, C2PA-aligned ingestion bridge), a community-scale provenance benchmark with a defense-escalation experiment, and a multi-hop harness; the preprint is reframed to lead with faithfulness-by-construction and to position against prior attributed-generation work.
